steps.name: Web level first
steps.goal: Wait for the 'My web level app' card. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The card shows the web preview inline, with icon tabs for Web and Your phone under it and a full screen button.

steps.name: Switch to Your phone
steps.goal: Tap the 'Your phone' tab under the preview once.
steps.done: The card shows one 'Open in Expo Go' button with a short account caption.
